capabilities: Insert a random Korean saying from the command palette
Replace the {{daily-saying-kr}} placeholder automatically in opened notes
Serve sayings offline from a local dataset
extras: At the time of writing the plugin is not yet in the community plugin directory and must be installed manually from a GitHub release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert random Korean-language sayings or quotes into notes.
summary: Plugin that inserts a random Korean saying into the current note via a command or a template placeholder, using an offline local dataset.
